# EvLoadingOverlay

> A full-page loading state. Blocked mode covers the page with the EVOQ wordmark tracing itself over an 80% scrim and stops all interaction; popup mode is a small card with the spinner that leaves the page usable.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:loading-overlay` |
| Layer | Organism (`src/organisms`) |
| Import | `import { EvLoadingOverlay } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvLoadingOverlay>` or `<ev-loading-overlay>` |
| Source | `src/organisms/loading-overlay/EvLoadingOverlay.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<Teleport>` |

## Example

```vue
<EvLoadingOverlay
  mode="popup"
  label="Memuat data..."
  close-on-escape
/>
```

_The exact snippet the playground simulator copies for this component (`playground/simulator-demos.ts`)._

## Props (4)

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `modelValue` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Whether the loader is on screen. |
| `mode` | `'popup'` \| `'blocked'` | `'blocked'` | no | `blocked` covers and blocks the page; `popup` is a small card that does not. |
| `label` | `string` | `'Memuat...'` | no | Announced to assistive tech, and shown in the popup card. |
| `closeOnEscape` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Escape turns it off (`update:modelValue` false). Off by default - a blocked loader is meant to stop the user; this is the way out for a playground or a stuck request. |

**Two-way binding:** `v-model`
